# Igris 2.1.2 - Chrome reading companion

- Igris Reader adds a visible in-page Chrome panel for selected-word meanings, sentence explanations, translation into English and keyboard follow-ups.
- The panel supports ordinary HTML fullscreen containers, draggable positioning, responsive Markdown, Stop and inline error recovery.
- A narrow Windows native-messaging bridge uses existing desktop model settings, token budgets and protected provider keys. Keys are not stored in the extension or sent to webpages. Reading conversations stay temporary; workspace writes and automatic page extraction are not included.
- Enable the bridge in Settings > Tools, then load the bundled reader/chrome folder once through chrome://extensions > Developer mode > Load unpacked. See CHROME_READER.md.

This does not bypass website fullscreen/focus checks, monitoring, protected viewers or assessment restrictions. Chrome's built-in PDF viewer and replaced fullscreen surfaces may not support an in-page interface. The supplied assessment site was not tested in an authenticated session.

Android remains 2.1.0; production signing is still deferred until after V2.3. Core and scheduling are unchanged.
